name: Para Academy
summary: In Para Academy you face a demanding paratrooper training program – only those who succeed in every discipline can rise through the ranks. You tackle a variety of challenges that test endurance, strength, and timing, all under strict time limits. Each success moves you forward, while failure costs lives and forces you to try again. Completing disciplines unlocks bonus stages for extra points. With every promotion, the requirements increase, pushing you to improve your skills to keep up.
